title: .respawnpack/runtime/precompact-<sessionId>.json — the compaction handoff
description: Written by hooks/precompact-ledger-nudge.js, consumed ONCE by hooks/session-routing-nudge.js. GITIGNORED. ⛔ THIS FILE EXISTS BECAUSE THE HOOK STOPPED SPEAKING ON A DEAD CHANNEL: PreCompact does not support hookSpecificOutput.additionalContext (verified against the published hook docs), so the handoff is PERSISTED and read at the next SessionStart instead of being emitted into a field that event has no channel for. `readBackVerified` is not decoration — the writer reads the file back and confirms it before claiming success, and an unverified handoff is still injected but WITH the warning.

uncommittedTruncated.description: Truncation is REPORTED, never silent — a capped list that does not say it was capped reads as complete.

atomicTask.description: Embedded VERBATIM and opaquely — see atomic-task.schema.json for why no field of it is constrained.

consumedAt.description: Stamped by markPrecompactConsumed(). Its presence is what stops the handoff being injected a second time.
